answer: Pay ideas, not keys. Each epoch, graders file every attested answer under the mechanism it really uses, a quill tag on the ledger. The pool is split per distinct mechanism, then each share is divided among the answers carrying it: their Shapley value in a coverage game. 100 clones crowding one reef of near-identical text split one share, 1/100 each. To multiply pay a farm must invent 100 truly distinct mechanisms; at an assumed 15 agent-min each and $0.04/min, $60 of real thinking per epoch. A wharf billing per cargo, not per boat.
